description: Add or remove an MCP server or skill. For a skill, add copies the folder in from to Wisp's skills folder; remove only removes a skill there. Start a server's sign-in with add and its name. Turn a tool, skill or server off in this chat, or back on, from the next message. Turning on what the user's settings have off, or turning off search, use or manage, asks the user first. add or remove says how a tool is installed. Never put a key in name, from or keys; keys names environment variables and Wisp asks the user for their values.

action.description: on or off switches it in this chat; add or remove changes a saved server or skill.

from.description: For add skill, the local skill folder. For add server, the command line or address after the name in /mcp add. Leave it out to sign in to an already added server. Never put a key here.

keys.description: Names of environment variables the server reads, never their values. Wisp asks the user for missing keys. With add and an existing server name, sets those keys anew.

kind.description: Whether name is a tool, skill or server.

name.description: The tool, skill or server name. Never put a key here.

name: manage
